title: Room 1.5 · Hobgoblin Warrior (CR 1/2) and the fled Goblin Warrior (CR 1/4) · High, 100 XP · cleared, untouched
headline: The goblin had run to the hobgoblin, and two Magic Missiles killed them both. Floor 1 is cleared.

bullets.label: Prep
bullets.text: an hour's Short Rest so Arcane Recovery could bring back Magic Missile, the spell that ignores a hobgoblin's AC 18, and the coins left behind by the S door.

bullets.label: Cheese
bullets.text: Mage Hand opened the iron door from 6 sq back, across the rubble, so a longsword hit (2d10+1, with Advantage from Pack Tactics while the goblin stood beside it) was two rounds away.

bullets.label: The dice
bullets.text: the hobgoblin rolled a natural 20 for initiative and got two longbow shots (1d8+1 piercing + 3d4 poison each), missing on 6 and 14. Both Magic Missiles held. One dart killed the 1 HP goblin; the other five darts did 15 force dmg to the hobgoblin, enough to kill it.

bullets.label: A ruling
bullets.text: the goblin's XP was already given when it fled, so killing it adds none. The floor's loot is the coins rule only (a tenth of the XP); the hobgoblin's half plate and weapons aren't salvage. Ask if you want gear to be sellable.

bullets.label: Result
bullets.text: 20/20 HP, nothing lost but Arcane Recovery. XP 1,100 → 1,200. +10 GP, and he picks up the 15 GP from room 1.4: 25 GP on him.

bullets.label: Floor 1
bullets.text: cleared, 300 XP and 25 GP in 3 h 35 min. Level 4 is at 2,700 XP: 1,500 to go.

trace.text: From E7 in room 1.4 (6 sq, 9 m from the N door at E1), Mage Hand opens the door: 15 vs DC 10, cast.
Room 1.5 behind it, 9×9 m, a 9 m ceiling hung with chains. Initiative: Hobgoblin 23 (natural 20), Morten 10, Goblin 3 (natural 1).
Hobgoblin, in the doorway 7 sq away: Longbow vs AC 15, 6, miss.
Magic Missile: 20 vs DC 11, cast. 3 darts.
One dart on the Goblin, 2 force dmg: dead. Two on the Hobgoblin, 5 force dmg: 11 → 6 HP.
Hobgoblin morale (its goblin is dead): WIS save vs DC 10, 12, holds.
3 darts on the Hobgoblin, 10 force dmg: 6 → 0 HP. Dead.

foes.name: Hobgoblin Warrior
foes.notes: Pack Tactics: Advantage when an ally is next to the target; half plate and shield; darkvision 18 m

foes.name: Goblin Warrior
foes.notes: the one that fled room 1.2; Nimble Escape

fight.verdict: the rest for Magic Missile paid for itself
fight.loot: +10 GP, and the 15 GP back from room 1.4
